games.title: BlackNight Tech Demo
games.subtitle: Umbra Engine Showcase
games.tagline: See what the engine can do.
games.description: A free, downloadable showcase of the Umbra engine: volumetric night lighting, cloth and hair simulation, and the crowd system powering Eclipse Protocol. Includes a built-in benchmark that reports frame pacing, 1% lows, and a suggested preset for your machine.

news.title: Umbra Engine: behind the night lighting
news.body: Our rendering leads break down the volumetric system that lets a single streetlight carry an entire district, and why we rebuilt shadows from scratch.

news.title: Launcher 1.0: faster downloads, cleaner nights
news.body: Resumable downloads, per-title bandwidth caps, and a rebuilt library that remembers how you actually play.
